    HOW WE'RE UNIQUE

    Our clients get results because we hold them accountable to the actions it takes to be successful in their goals. And we keep them motivated along the way! Clients also build relationships within our family-like community built at the gym and in our private Facebook group. 

    RELATIONSHIPS

    Build support networks that go on your health journey with you. Your fitness family not only cheers for you, but goes through the transformation process with you.

    ACCOUNTABILITY

    The relationships formed keep you accountable to your own, personalized journey to health, and hold you up through the highs and lows.

    MOTIVATION

    Having a support system that holds you accountable, motivates you to fulfill the potential we see in you. Fitness with a support system is much more successful.

    SERVICES

    CONSULTATION

    GOALS

    We make sure that the services we offer here at BarNone are all customized to your goals. Most importantly, we provide accountability. The accountability aspect is making sure that whatever your goal is, we hold you accountable to what it takes to achieve it.

    EDUCATION

    NUTRITION

    Nutrition is the most important part of fitness. We offer nutritional coaching that is very simple, customizable and realistic. Discover practical food lessons and learn to embrace the joy of eating healthy. We will educate you on lifestyle shifts that will strengthen the foundation of your fitness journey.

    MOVEMENT

    TRAINING

    We offer many group fitness classes designed to meet all levels of fitness. Classes are personalized to the way each person moves with consideration of personal goals. We have over 40 variations of class types that focus on different movements to keep you in a position to be successful and not bored.
